SELECT d.*, c.name as category_name FROM device_info d LEFT JOIN device_category c ON d.category_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE d.deleted = 0
AND d.device_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{deviceNo}, '%')
AND d.device_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{deviceName}, '%')
AND d.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND d.status = #{status}
AND d.department LIKE CONCAT('%', #{department}, '%')
ORDER BY d.create_time DESC
